messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000289": Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Farah for the job scheduler handover on 2025-04-04.  (about: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000273": The notifier's previous flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000264" [decision]: Marcus Oyelaran is on call for the Boreal team this cycle, taking over from Lena as of 2025-03-31.  (about: Boreal, Lena, Marcus Oyelaran)
- memory_id "1000237": Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens.  (about: Ledger, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000234" [decision]: Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember)
- memory_id "1000232": After the cache change, the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000223" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds as follow-up to INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000216": Notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000196" [decision]: The indexer belongs to the Boreal team as of 2025-02-28.  (about: Boreal, indexer)
- memory_id "1000193" [constraint]: The webhooks service has a deploy window on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000149": The reports pipeline depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export, so if Ledger is down the reports pipeline is down.  (about: Ledger, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000138": The authentication gateway lives with team Ember.  (about: Ember, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000103": The product catalog lives with the Cinder team as of 2025-01-17.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000095" [decision]: The first on-call rotation for team Ember goes to Oskar.  (about: Oskar, Ember)
- memory_id "1000084": Oskar is the only engineer on team Ember as of 2025-01-10.  (about: Oskar, Ember)
- memory_id "1000068": The webhooks service is a Boreal service as of 2025-01-09.  (about: Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000061": Boreal owns notifier.  (about: Boreal, notifier)
- memory_id "1000057": The event bus is a Boreal service.  (about: Boreal, event bus)
- memory_id "1000031": Ledger is owned by Team Atlas as of 2025-01-08.  (about: Team Atlas, Ledger)
- memory_id "1000011": The Boreal roster consists of Lena and Marcus Oyelaran as of 2025-01-07.  (about: Boreal, Lena, Marcus Oyelaran)
Existing entity names: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler, notifier, push provider, Boreal, Lena, Marcus Oyelaran, Ledger, authentication gateway, Ember, webhooks service, INC-2025-004, indexer, reports pipeline, Cinder, product catalog, event bus, Team Atlas

The note:

[2025-04-11] handover/2025-04-11-webhooks: Quick one: webhooks belongs to team Ember starting today. Thanks to Boreal for running it until now.
